observation.command:
echo "=== Containers ==="; docker ps --format "{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}" | grep -E "keycloak|mssql"
echo "=== Export file (generated at startup by XmlExportStrassen job) ==="; ls -la /workspace/src/Backend/Lecos.Strassennamen.RestAPI/Export/ 2>/dev/null
echo "=== DB tables created by migrations ==="; docker exec mssql /opt/mssql-tools18/bin/sqlcmd -S localhost -U sa -P 'Strassen#2024' -C -d Strassennamen -Q "SELECT name FROM sys.tables ORDER BY name" 2>/dev/null
echo "=== Processes listening ==="; (ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null || netstat -ltnp 2>/dev/null) | grep -E ":4200|:5000|:8080|:1433"
